# RoofRunner
RoofRunner: A Raspberry Pi-powered, Pololu-driven roll-off-roof observatory controller. ASCOM compatibility, roof limits, and proprietary TOADS™ connector retention technology. Keeps expensive telescopes out of the rain.

### 4.2 Expected behavior

- When open is open and closed is closed, roof is open.
- When open is closed, and closed is open, roof is closed.

## 8. Development and Communication Interfaces

### Raspberry Pi

- Headless Linux environment.
- SSH access enabled.
- VS Code Remote SSH operational.
- Git repository: `EorEquis/RoofRunner`.

### Pololu SMC

- Model: Simple Motor Controller G2 18v15.
- Motor supply: nominal 12V DC.
- Communication: TTL UART.
- Error indication: ERR output to GPIO18.
- Limit-switch inputs: configured on the SMC.
